sample_unit: physicians and advanced practice providers (survey respondents)

links.outcome: Clinician burnout and intent to leave after AI scribe deployment, by professional role
links.effect: Physicians reported reduced burnout and intent to leave; APPs had no significant reduction in burnout or intent to leave. Both groups showed reduced cognitive task load.
links.quote: Physicians reported reduced burnout and intent to leave; however, APPs did not have a significant reduction in burnout or intent to leave.

unlisted_practices: Measuring cognitive task load among clinicians before and after AI scribe deployment
Comparing AI scribe effects across professional roles (physicians vs advanced practice providers)

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of generative AI scribes on clinician cognitive load and well-being via pre- and post-implementation surveys.
